core_obligations: Reduce to an irreducible complement at a generic point (proof lines 7527-7530).
Assume codimension at least two and apply the extension criterion (proof lines 7530-7535).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: in the situation of the structure sheaf lemma, if the section s is nonzero then every irreducible component of X setminus U has codimension 1 in X (source lines 7520-7525). The proof takes a generic point of such a component, shrinks to make the complement irreducible, and argues by contradiction: if the codimension were at least 2 the extension criterion for reflexive modules on a normal scheme would promote the isomorphism s : O_U -> F|_U to an isomorphism on X, forcing the complement to be empty.
